title: ghs_-prefixed values with an incomplete JWT
summary: Two synthetic ghs_-prefixed values cut from the stateless literal: the app id, header and payload with no signature (one dot), and the app id and header only (no dot).
rationale: The documented tests are two dots for the stateless form and none for the opaque form; one dot satisfies neither, and a header-only value has no dot yet is 48 characters. The recommended expression still matches both. Whether either is a token, a truncation of one, or neither is not documented.

expectation.rationale: No expectation is asserted. The provider describes complete tokens only; truncated or incomplete JWT segments are not addressed, so neither an outcome nor the extent of a finding can be derived from the sources.

sources.supports: Stateless token is a ghs_-prefixed JWT with two dots; recommended expression ghs_[A-Za-z0-9\.\-_]{36,}.
sources.locator: How to use it; Verifying the token type

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

relations.note: Signature segment, or payload and signature, removed from the stateless literal.
